name: Enchanting tables
note: Enchanting tables make three offers from the bookshelves around them (the power provider and transmitter block tags) and the player's enchantment seed: their level costs, the enchantments each shows and their levels, drawn as both official servers draw them from the data packs' in_enchanting_table enchantments, weights, cost ranges, primary items and exclusive sets and the wiki's enchantability by material; an offer is taken for its place in levels and lapis (any in creative mode), a book becoming an enchanted book that loses one enchantment; 320 windows of the official servers with two other seeds and a 97-step scenario and a 64-step survey give the same windows, offers, enchantments and levels as both official servers
deviations: a new player's enchantment seed and the seed after enchanting are Circuit's own; the official servers draw them at random
stacks with several enchantments keep the order they were drawn in; the official servers keep a hash order of their own
